ev-rotate.intro.say: This replaces the key this machine uses to open what Evalation sends it.

ev-rotate.lost.say: Email support@evalation.ai and we'll switch that machine off.

ev-rotate.replaced.say: Replaced this machine's key. The old key no longer works.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-clock.say: The key wasn't replaced, and the old one still works. Set this machine's clock to the right time, then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-key-store.say: The key wasn't replaced, and the old one still works. Unlock this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac), then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-replaced-other.say: The key wasn't replaced, and the old one still works. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll fix it.

ev-rotate.not-finished-clock.say: The key change didn't finish, and Evalation may not work on this machine until it does. Set the clock to the right time, then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-finished-unreachable.say: The key change didn't finish, and Evalation may not work on this machine until it does. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-finished-key-store.say: The key change didn't finish, and Evalation may not work on this machine until it does. Unlock this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac), then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.not-finished-other.say: The key change didn't finish, and Evalation may not work on this machine until it does. Run /ev-rotate again, and if it fails again, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-rotate.damaged-named.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged, so the key wasn't replaced. Run /ev-activate and sign in with <email>.

ev-rotate.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged, so the key wasn't replaced. Run /ev-activate and sign in with the same account as before.

ev-rotate.unclear.say: This machine's sign-in couldn't be read, so the key wasn't replaced. Unlock this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac), then run /ev-rotate again.

ev-rotate.no-key.say: Part of this machine's sign-in can't be read, so the key wasn't replaced. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll fix it.
